A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 10 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 10 epochs old, anchored at a timber checkpoint. The attacker spends 60 dollars and 18 days per identity before it can vote at all.
